title: Implement XCID command: return CID for current article
description:
Why: CID-aware clients (pinning scripts, indexers) may want to retrieve the CID for the article at the current cursor position without fetching the full article body. XCID is an X-prefixed command per RFC 3977 §7.2, so it is experimental/non-standard and only sent by clients that have confirmed XCID capability via CAPABILITIES.

What: XCID with no arguments returns the CID of the current article (same semantics as STAT — requires a group selected and a current article pointer). XCID <message-id> returns the CID for any article by message-id regardless of current group context. Response: 290 <cid> on success (new response code in the 2xx experimental range); 412 if no group selected (no-arg form); 423 if no current article; 430 if message-id not found.
design: Response code 290 chosen as the experimental slot — RFC 3977 §3.2 reserves 2xx for success, and 290 is unassigned. Command parsing: add XCID arm to dispatch.rs. Lookup: MsgIdMap::get(message_id) → Option<Cid>. Format: '290 bafyrei...' (single line). Advertise as 'XCID' keyword in CAPABILITIES list.
